features.notes: Object basePdf width 58 mm and finite height from 1 through 2000 mm.
Object basePdf width 80 mm and finite height from 1 through 2000 mm.
Each schemas entry becomes an ordered clipped canvas separated by page_break.
Named schemas bind using RFC 6901 JSON Pointer escaping (~ as ~0 and / as ~1); unnamed content is literal.
Font size is retained; Piqae controls font face and shaping.
Named QR schemas bind using an RFC 6901 JSON Pointer token and render within the declared clipped box.
Horizontal line position and declared clipping box are retained.
Finite top-left millimetre coordinates, dimensions, source ordering and deterministic clipping are retained for supported primitives.
Existing/background PDF data is never fetched or executed.
document/v1 has a bounded flow-table node, but this adapter does not yet map pdfme table schemas.
Only QR is available in document/v1.
No remote or embedded source fonts are accepted by this adapter.
Arbitrary pdfme plugins or JavaScript are never loaded or run.
